Pauzza Test Privacy Policy

Test version 0.1 · From the day you connect until 25 November 2026

  1. Who is responsible. U trust LLC, ID code 406273786, 50/18 Ketevan Tsamebuli Ave / Bochorma St., Commercial Space 5, Block C, Floors 1-2 (duplex), Isani District, Tbilisi, Georgia, hello@pauzza.ge.

  2. What we never collect. Your code, prompts, conversations or files; your name, phone or payment details; your waiting time or usage figures. The meter's usage numbers are read on your computer and never sent.

  3. What the server keeps after you press "Connect".

    • A random number for your install, a short reference shown in ⚙, and when you connected.
    • The test codes you claim, and when.
    • A record of what you accepted, and of any disconnection.

    We use this to run the test: to give you test codes and to stop the same code going to two people. The offer list is the same for everyone and is downloaded without your install number. We build no profile of you and sell nothing.

  4. Your network (IP) address. The server sees it when the add-on contacts it. It is not saved with your install. Our hosting keeps it in technical logs for at most 7 days, and limits on requests keep only a scrambled form of it, for 24 hours.

  5. Where the data is. The database is in Frankfurt, in the EU. It is run for us by Supabase, whose providers, such as Amazon Web Services, Cloudflare and Google, may access it from other countries, including the USA. Emails to hello@pauzza.ge are kept by our email provider.

  6. Disconnecting. Switch the connection off in ⚙, free, at any time. We then delete your install record. The records of codes you claimed stay, without any link to you. Codes already on your computer keep working until their use-by date.

  7. After the test. The test ends on 25 November 2026 (or up to 7 days later, if we say so in the add-on). Within 14 days after that, we delete all install records and claimed codes. The records of what people accepted are kept for 1 year, as proof. Backups disappear within 7 more days. Emails are deleted within 12 months.

  8. Your rights. You can ask what we hold, and ask us to correct it, delete it or stop using it. Write to hello@pauzza.ge with the short reference shown in ⚙; we answer within 10 working days. You can complain to the State Audit Service of Georgia or a court. Pauzza is for people 18 or older.

  9. Changes. If Pauzza later shows real offers, it will first show a new policy and ask you to press "Connect" again.
